title: Warehouse Wi-Fi Incident Response
description: Warehouse Wi-Fi failures affecting logistics operations
triggers: Complete Wi-Fi outage at warehouse locations
immediate_actions: Identify scope of Wi-Fi failure (single warehouse vs multi-warehouse)
Notify warehouse management of connectivity status
Implement wired connections for critical devices if available
investigation_steps: Check wireless access point status and logs
Verify network connectivity to access points
Analyze wireless signal patterns and interference
resolution_steps: Restart failed access points following standard procedures
Implement network controller fixes if needed
Apply wireless configuration changes or optimizations
Coordinate with wireless vendor for complex issues
verification: Test Wi-Fi connectivity at affected warehouses
Check wireless coverage in warehouse areas
Confirm with warehouse staff that Wi-Fi is operational
special_considerations: Coordinate with local warehouse management before restarting network equipment
Warehouse operations may rely on wireless devices
